summary.zh: 对失败项目做无责复盘并登记改进
summary.en: Blameless 5-Whys review with a change register after a failure

description.zh: 用于发布失败、季度目标落空或招聘失误之后。用连续追问找根因，把责任放在流程而不是个人身上，并把改进措施登记成可跟踪的变更。适合团队要总结经验又不想互相指责的时候。
description.en: Runs after a failed launch, a missed quarter or a bad hire. Uses repeated why-questions to reach root causes without blaming individuals, then logs each fix in a change register. Keeps the review honest enough that people speak up.
